article.title: Ok, Now Don’t F**k It Up!
article.author: Ted Vaill
article.content: The opinions expressed here are solely the author's and do not reflect the opinions or beliefs of the LA Progressive. A few days ago, before the Midterm election, I was hoping for, but not really expecting, a Blue Wave. But we now clearly have a Blue Tsunami - Democrats will be in the majority, by a large margin, in both houses of Congress and a have a strong majority of governors, and in all the largest states except Florida. All the “battleground” states now have Democratic governors and the “trifecta” of the governor and both houses of the legislature. There is also a chance that next year the Interstate Compact will become law (it needs passage from states with a total of 48 more electoral votes), and if this happens the 2028 Presidential election will be decided by the U.S. popular vote and not the small state-favoring Electoral College. In 2028, there will be 19 GOP Senate seats up for election, and 15 Democrat seats. Included in the GOP Senators up for reelection (unless they retire) are: Ashley Moody again (who just squeaked through in Florida); Chuck Grassley (who would be over 100 years old at the end of his term if he wins); Cranky Rand Paul; Trumpster Tim Scott; former Majority leader John Thune; and slick Ron Johnson of Wisconsin. Related: My Family Helped Build America: Donald Trump Is Tearing It Apart And a number of the GOP Senators up for reelection in 2018 have shown that they are willing to work with Democrats to get things done. If the Democrats end up winning the seats in Alaska and Mississippi, they would have 56, and would only need 4 Republican Senators to reach a filibuster-free 60 votes. And 2030 is not much better for the GOP in the Senate. In the House, the Democrat majority might even reach 260 next January (218 is a majority).Impeachment only requires a majority in the House, but 67 in the Senate (out of reach unless a number of Republican Senators decide to flush Lame Duck Trump and/or Warmonger Hegseth. Don’t ruin it The Democrats have a history of screwing up a sure thing, by trying to go for too much. Both Clinton and Obama tried to fix the health care system, and the voters punished them in 1994 and 2010.Medicare for all is the right thing to do, but how is it going to be paid for? How do the Democrats fix the economy and healthcare when Trump blew up the national debt to $40 Trillion? Since 2000, our Electoral College-favored GOP Presidents have grossly expanded the debt, leaving it for the Democratic Presidents that follow them to fix the problem. It will happen again in 2028. Related: Trump Denied Project 2025: Now He’s Carrying It Out And then there is 80-year-old and looking unwell and perhaps mentally unstable Trump. What will he do now that the voters have stripped him of much of his power? Bomb-bomb-bomb Iran? Create a Reichstag-like fire to allow him to impose the Insurrection Act on the American people? What will the leaders of the military not fired by Trump choose to do if Trump and Hegseth ask them to follow illegal and unconstitutional orders? What if the Republican leader in the House (possibly current Speaker Johnson, who has chosen not to be the Minority Leader in the next Congress, leaving it to Majority Leader Scalise or Jimmy “I love to wrestle boys” Jordan), try to prevent the seating of new Democratic Congressmembers next January 3? Jordan was deeply in bed with Trump on 1/6/20. Could Trump work with him to create another 1/6 coup to cause chaos as the new Congress is being certified? Many of us who voted for change in the Midterms won’t allow it to happen.
